s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with butter and wholegrain mustard.

s.note: the ceremony in the mountains of Bhutan
s.how: Mix 400g chicken mince with sliced spring onion and grated ginger. Fill dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam for 10 minutes. Char 3 tomatoes in a dry pan and blitz with chilli flakes and salt for a dipping sauce.

m.how: Pound 4 pork loin steaks thin, then crumb in flour, beaten egg and panko. Fry in butter until golden on both sides. Boil 800g potatoes, slice and toss warm with a little vinegar, oil and salt. Serve the schnitzel with lemon wedges.

w.how: Beat 300g butter with 300g sugar, add 5 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour. Bake in 3 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with buttercream and raspberry jam and ice white with icing sugar beaten into butter. Fit for a bakery wedding.

d.how: Crush 125g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of half a lemon, then push through a sieve to remove the seeds. Spoon 1 tbsp of the purée into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle, letting the foam settle as you pour. Drop a whole raspberry into each glass. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice.
